basic_details.short_information: The Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) has officially announced the Contract Engineer (Field Firing) Recruitment 2026 with 3 openings. The detailed notification has been published on the official website, https://bdl-india.in. Candidates who are not more than 55 years of age and possess a Diploma in Electronics Engineering or Army-certified courses in Electronics/GCE are eligible to apply. The application process is being conducted through email, and candidates can submit their applications up to 21-08-2026. Direct links to download the official notification and application details are shared below

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for BDL Contract Engineer (Field Firing) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BDL Contract Engineer (Field Firing) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 21st August 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Contract Engineer (Field Firing) post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 47,000/- per month for the duration of their contract period.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Electronics Engineering or have completed Army certified courses in Electronics or GCE to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Contract Engineer (Field Firing) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this post is 55 years as of the notification date.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the BDL Contract Engineer (Field Firing) job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address provided in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) is recruiting for a total of 3 vacancies for the post of Contract Engineer (Field Firing).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Contract Engineer (Field Firing) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Contract Engineer (Field Firing) position will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for BDL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this BDL recruitment?
faq.answer: The positions advertised are contractual in nature. Candidates will be appointed on a contract basis for the specified period.
